findings.note: Closed 2026-11-13 (docs/plans/research/2026-11-13-2026.md, 3.6). Newgrange and Ness of Brodgar have dated records (literature_dates.csv; Newgrange's own XRONOS dates via records.toml [[keep_site]]). Mehrgarh is east of the board (decision 0.4; data/renown/SOURCES.md). Karahan Tepe is left out: no radiocarbon date of the site is published. Karul 2021 (Buried Buildings at Pre-Pottery Neolithic Karahantepe, Turk Arkeoloji ve Etnografya Dergisi 82:21-31, https://dergipark.org.tr/en/download/article-file/1683122) dates its structures only as Late PPNA and Early PPNB; Wikipedia's 9750-9400 BCE rests on a news report, and 2026 news of the diet study gives no dates. Add it when the excavators publish dates.
